mapper.insert: INSERT INTO workflow (tenant_id, code, name, category, version, status, island_id) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{code}, #{name}, #{category}, 1, 1, #{islandId})
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) AS "total", count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 2) AS "published", count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.status = 1) AS "draft", count(*) FILTER (WHERE w.island_id IS NULL) AS "noIsland", count(*) FILTER ( WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task') ) AS "emptyGraph" FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT count(*) FROM workflow w WHERE w.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND w.deleted_at IS NULL
AND w.category = #{category}
AND (w.name ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%' OR w.code ILIKE '%' || #{q} || '%')
AND w.island_id IS NULL AND w.island_id = #{islandId}::bigint
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = w.id AND n.node_type = 'task')

SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", params->'time_constraint'->>'after_node_key' AS "afterKey", COALESCE((params->'time_constraint'->>'min_sec')::int, 0) AS "minSec", COALESCE((params->'time_constraint'->>'max_sec')::int, 0) AS "maxSec" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' AND params->'time_constraint' IS NOT NULL

SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", params->'method_params' AS "mp",
params->>'protocol_name' AS "protocolName" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task' AND params->'method_params' IS NOT NULL
SELECT node_key AS "nodeKey", id AS "id" FROM workflow_node WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND workflow_id = #{param2} AND node_type = 'task'

SELECT n.node_key AS "nodeKey", cap.code AS "cap" FROM workflow_node n JOIN capability cap ON cap.id = n.capability_id WHERE n.tenant_id = #{param1} AND n.workflow_id = #{param2} AND n.node_type = 'task'
mapper.update: UPDATE workflow SET attr = jsonb_set(coalesce(attr, '{}'::jsonb), '{maxIterations}', to_jsonb(#{param3}::int), true), updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}
